trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum lands once the other 54 trophies are yours. There is nothing extra to do beyond them — finish the list and this pops with it. One playthrough is enough, and nothing here needs online play.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in the chapter that can disappear.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only — work through the main missions and this pops at the chapter's end. Most of the open-world list opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only. The robbery tools and bank jobs that feed several other trophies start appearing in this chapter, so take the optional missions as they come.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — the vault jobs in this chapter feed Maximum Withdrawal, so do them as they appear.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and the credits. This is the last story trophy. Keep a manual save from before the final mission — there is no mission replay, and free roam continues after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the story; play it through to the end and the trophy pops with the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It unlocks as you play through the chapter — no side work is needed, just finish the job.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at the airport. Story only — play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — it pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it only appears after the story, though progress made during the story already counts). The checklist is forgiving: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion. It asks for 100 optional tasks; robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday jobs, 34 of 35 smash'n'grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, all 8 vaults); fencing $100,000 of narcotics, $100,000 of jewelry, $250,000 of marked bills and $200,000 of vehicles; collectibles (15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater finds, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 flamingos); scanning (200 of 277 vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals); and activities (30 of 40 races, gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges, 42 drone trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks). Expect around 200 hours for the Platinum as a whole, at difficulty 4 out of 10. Do the checklist after the credits, in free roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida — jumps, airtime and landing tricks the game tracks as you pull them off. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this one.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races and the rest. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold is the top tier, so work on timing and weapon handling — the challenges are short and repeatable. The 100% checklist needs all 42 golds too, so this is not optional for the Platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. The drones handle the same everywhere, so each race comes down to learning the course line — run a practice lap, then race it clean.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — road, off-road, on water — so pick the ones you are best at. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races, so this is a waypoint on the way there.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him — steady, even reeling beats frantic input, and keeping the line tension in the safe zone matters more than speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish a full arcade game. Any cabinet, any game — see one through to its end screen. It does not need a high score, just a completed run.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Work through Andy's mission strand as it opens up; the last mission in the strand pops this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand runs through his underwater treasure diving; complete his missions in order and the last one pops this.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission — it pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. These are the odd jobs and encounters marked on the map — take them as they appear. OutputLag notes one Chapter 3 race, Against Yago, is time-sensitive, so do not leave every strand for after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's strand as it opens up; the last mission pops this.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission — it pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice, so bring both. Track the count at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — the one missable trophy: the first meditation is offered by Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth. It vanishes once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it before leaving Chapter 1. Whether it is strictly required for the trophy is still unconfirmed — do not risk it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for specific animals; follow his targets and take the shot cleanly. The 100% checklist needs all 15 of his target decks, so keep hunting past this one.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found around Leonida — in shops, out in the world and as job rewards. The 100% checklist asks for 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are the photo and tag points dotted around the map — stop at them as you travel and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks everywhere — driving, combat, exploration and more. 70 of 80 are needed for 100%, so treat this as a milestone, not the end.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level together, then break line of sight and get clear — hiding spots and fast driving both work, and the trophy pops once the heat is fully gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in one run while the heat stays on — plan a route through nearby shops, keep moving, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you spot and scan counts; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so keep scanning everything you meet on the road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a grouped fight, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it runs out — crowded shootouts are the place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, the airport. PowerPyx and OutputLag point to the gates on the airfield side — get a vehicle moving fast and leave the airport grounds without following a scheduled route.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank at the Mile Zero Air Station and take it for a spin. The tanks are parked at the air station; the trophy is about driving one, so expect a wanted level and a chase the moment you roll out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. PowerPyx names the Snap Gun approach and Richardson Jewelry as the spot — go quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and get out clean before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up in Chapters 3 and 4; each one is a planned job — get in, crack the vault, and lose the heat afterwards. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep robbing past this one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, and outrun the response — a fast getaway car and a planned route make this far easier than improvising.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the state — Vice City and the counties around it — and the trophy pops once the whole map is on your radar. Driving the highways end to end fills most of it in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one for each gang. The 100% checklist counts 39 gang operations in total, so keep hitting them after this pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger at launch. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list it as not yet known. This entry will not guess: check back once players confirm how it unlocks.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger at launch. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list it as not yet known. This entry will not guess: check back once players confirm how it unlocks.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. PowerPyx ties this to Kingpin Bowling and three valuables at the alley — bowl a full game and pick up what is there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build Strength at the gym with your partner. OutputLag and KeenGamer link this to training Strength together — put in the gym sessions until the partnership milestone lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 Criminal Profile actions. The Criminal Profile tracks your choices across the game; keep making them and the count grows. OutputLag and KeenGamer note the profile is permanent, so play the way you mean to.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger at launch. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list it as not yet known. This entry will not guess: check back once players confirm how it unlocks.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger at launch. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list it as not yet known. This entry will not guess: check back once players confirm how it unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as to the exact trigger. KeenGamer describes it as a melee drive-by at the bowling alley, but PowerPyx still lists the precise method as not yet known — treat any specific step as unverified until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from jobs; fence them through contacts until the $250,000 total is reached — the same total the 100% checklist asks for.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles, food — every purchase counts, so this will come naturally across a full playthrough if you buy gear as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages, costing around $160,000 in total per PowerPyx — buy them all and this pops. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. PowerPyx points to Moses for the Scooter Bros setup — register vehicles through the app until you reach ten.
